title: Accessibility & comfort
blurb: Bigger text, reading aloud, dictation, magnifier, eye strain.

remedies.title: Have the computer read text aloud
remedies.why: Both systems can read selected text or the whole screen aloud.

steps.text: Edge and Word: Read aloud (right-click or Review tab). Narrator for the whole screen: Windows+Ctrl+Enter.
Accessibility › Spoken Content › Speak selection (Option+Esc). VoiceOver: ⌘F5.

remedies.title: Type with my voice (dictation)
remedies.why: Built-in dictation turns speech into text in any app.

steps.text: Press Windows+H in any text box.
Press the microphone key or Fn twice; turn it on in Keyboard › Dictation.
Allow the microphone if it doesn't hear you.

remedies.title: Zoom in on part of the screen
remedies.why: Magnifiers enlarge what's under the pointer.

steps.text: Windows+Plus starts Magnifier; Windows+Esc stops it.
Accessibility › Zoom: use a keyboard shortcut or scroll with a modifier key.

remedies.title: Screen is tiring my eyes
remedies.why: Brightness, glare, small text and long sessions all add up.

steps.text: Match screen brightness to the room; use Night light / Night Shift in the evening.
Match screen brightness to the room; use Night Shift in the evening.
Make text larger and try dark mode.
Every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds.

remedies.title: Make the screen easier to read (contrast, bold text)
remedies.why: Contrast themes and bolder text help low vision.

steps.text: Accessibility › Contrast themes (Left Alt+Left Shift+Print Screen toggles).
Accessibility › Display › Increase contrast, Reduce transparency.

remedies.title: "Do you want to turn on Sticky Keys?" keeps popping up
remedies.why: Pressing Shift five times (or holding it) triggers the accessibility shortcut.

steps.text: Accessibility › Keyboard: turn off the keyboard shortcuts for Sticky, Filter and Toggle Keys.

remedies.title: Turn off animations (motion sickness or a slow computer)
remedies.why: Window animations can cause discomfort and use resources.

steps.text: Accessibility › Visual effects › Animation effects off.

remedies.title: Control the computer by voice
remedies.why: Voice Access (Windows) and Voice Control (Mac) let you click, type and navigate by speaking.
